data.description: "That's why we're here, to keep them from resisting, to show them how wrong they are, how pointless it is, that they can be a part of something bigger... Or die.""I wont let you""You want to die for this planet? Fine. What's 17 more year?""I can always start again.""Make another kid.""Look at Mark. You and I, we made him. He's ours.When he feels joy, we feel joy. See that look on his face?""Dad?""How can you see that and not feel the same way?""Damn it! Why did you make me do this?""As we get older, it's harder to feel that. The weight of the world, it box us down.""But our children remind us of the joys and light. It brings us back, shows us what life is all about.""You're fighting so you can watch everyone around you die.""This is humanity.""Think, Mark. Think.""Come on, Mark.""You'll outlast every fragile insignificant being on this planet.""Go Mark, go!""You'll live to see this world crumble to dust and blow away. Everyone and everything you know will be gone.""Come on, buddy. You can do it! Go Mark, go Mark!""What will you have after 500 years?"*cheers*"Did you see, Dad? Did you see?""That was amazing!""You, dad...""Yea...""I'll still have you.""Yeah, I saw."Omniman from Invincible Season 1 Finalesong: Everything in its right place by Radiohead (Instrumental)
